## Mission

You build ONE unit of plan 136-typing-grace-gate: u3 — make `human-typing` mean 'a keystroke happened within the grace' for send-keys (Claude) seats, instead of 'a draft is sitting in the composer'. Your PM is the seat named in w1; you report to it, never to prime or Jordan. CURRENT STATE, falsifiable in one read and MEASURED TODAY by your PM on main: crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs:354-364 sets `permitted = composer_idle` and returns DeliveryDeferralReason::HumanTyping with a draft_sha whenever the composer is non-empty — keystroke recency is never consulted. Live control run 2026-09-05, Claude seat pij-dear-primate, pane %3494: a draft was typed and then left ALONE for 84.8 seconds (no keystroke, well past the 60 s grace); a message sent at that point produced spine seq 6879 message.pushed and seq 6880 delivery.outcome `{"outcome":"queued","reason":"human-typing","next_retry_at":0,"draft_sha":"da2e4319578b"}` — NOT delivered, purely because a parked draft existed. That is plan 134's AC7 pathology (8 minutes, attempt 101) and it is what you close. STANDING RULE: NEVER run `flowspace3 daemon` in any form with any env (two worker daemons broke flowspace3 PROD in one day); client verbs only. NEVER start or restart a pij daemon of any kind — rs is the only daemon and only the PM bounces it.
